findings.mechanism: The first verb acts on the same object repeated in the purpose verb; wa-idhan opens the consequence block, where negation and the final measure answer the attempted plan.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader follows one causal sequence through the whole ayah.
findings.containment: The sequence is a grammatical and rhetorical relation; it does not assert that the intended expulsion succeeded.

epistemic.reason: The repeated object, purpose attachment, and response-particle clause are all present in the focus.

findings.title: Completed purpose clause
findings.claim: The purpose clause identifies the aim, action, object, and source in one complete construction.
findings.mechanism: Li governs the subjunctive expulsion verb, its suffix marks the addressed object, and minha supplies the source; together they close the clause's account of what the hostile group intends.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see that the expulsion phrase specifies both whom and from where.
findings.containment: Completeness of the clause does not mean completion of the intended action.

epistemic.reason: The focus morphology and attachment evidence supply each role in the purpose construction.

findings.title: Anaphoric source return
findings.claim: The feminine pronoun in minha returns the second source phrase to the same land named earlier.
findings.mechanism: Al-ardh establishes the source complement for the hostile purpose; min-ha repeats that preposition and attaches its pronoun to the land antecedent, so the later phrase cannot drift into an abstract exit.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the attempted removal back to one concrete point of departure.
findings.containment: The pronoun refers to the supplied land noun and adds no new source.

epistemic.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the feminine suffix as referring to al-ardh and functioning as the expulsion verb's source complement.

findings.title: Compact source repetition
findings.claim: Min-ha reinforces the earlier source relation in a shorter form without restating the noun.
findings.mechanism: The fused preposition and feminine pronoun repeat min al-ardh's source structure, while anaphora compresses the second mention to the pronoun alone.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the removal frame is repeated but not reopened.
findings.containment: The two phrases refer to the same source relation, not to separate territories.

epistemic.reason: The supplied focus form and its earlier min al-ardh antecedent establish compact repetition.

findings.title: Consequence pivot
findings.claim: The second wa joins the hostile purpose to the consequence that answers it.
findings.mechanism: The connector follows the completed purpose clause and leads into idhan and the non-remaining clause; it pivots from what the group intends to do to what follows for them.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the second half as an answer to the first half's hostile plan.
findings.containment: The conjunction names a local relation, not the divine agent behind the consequence.

epistemic.reason: The QAC and attachment evidence mark wa as the link into the apodosis after the purpose clause.

findings.title: Response consequence
findings.claim: Idhan marks the non-remaining clause as the consequence of the expulsion scenario.
findings.mechanism: The response particle opens the result after the purpose clause, making the group's curtailed stay a consequence rather than an unrelated prediction.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can connect the imagined expulsion to the agents' own aftermath.
findings.containment: The result is locally framed as consequence; no unmentioned cause is supplied.

epistemic.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify idhan as a response particle introducing the result clause.

findings.title: Orientation reversal
findings.claim: The result clause turns attention from the group's action against the Prophet to the group's own duration after him.
findings.mechanism: Idhan opens the response, and khilafaka later makes the addressed person the measure of their remaining; the subject of the threat becomes the reference point for its aftermath.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader feels the focus move from their agency to their limited tenure.
findings.containment: The shift is grammatical and relational; it does not name a new actor.

epistemic.reason: The result-particle and possessive-adverbial evidence jointly supports the local change in orientation.

findings.title: Written response form
findings.claim: The written form of idhan is visible at the hinge where the ayah turns from purpose to consequence.
findings.mechanism: Its written ending appears on the fixed response particle at the start of the result block, so the graphic form and clause position make the hinge perceptible together.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader notices the response turn at the point where the text marks it.
findings.containment: The orthography makes the hinge visible but does not independently alter the particle's syntax or claim extra emphasis.

epistemic.reason: This is a bounded surface-form observation supported by the supplied orthographic evidence; its interpretive effect is limited to marking the clause hinge.

findings.title: Negated persistence
findings.claim: La first denies durable remaining; the exception only later allows a small residue.
findings.mechanism: The negative particle scopes over yelbathun before illa introduces its limit, so the reader encounters denied persistence before the duration is measured.
findings.reader_payoff: The result is not merely a shortened stay; lasting presence is denied before any remainder is admitted.
findings.containment: The negation does not mean that the group never exists after the Prophet; the exception preserves a small amount of remaining.

epistemic.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify la as negating the remaining verb within a later exception frame.

findings.title: Restriction frame opener
findings.claim: La opens a restriction whose only permitted remainder is delayed until the final exception.
findings.mechanism: The negative particle establishes the closed side of the frame; illa appears later to admit qalilan, making the structure narrow toward its final allowance.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader feels the sentence hold the possible remainder back until the end.
findings.containment: This describes the local negation-exception structure, not a claim that duration is literally zero.

epistemic.reason: The supplied particles form the explicit negative-plus-exception construction.

findings.title: Denied duration
findings.claim: The consequence targets the opponents' ability to linger: their durable remaining is denied and only a brief measure survives.
findings.mechanism: Idhan frames the result, la negates yelbathun, and qalilan measures what illa permits; the verb's staying range is thus narrowed by the full construction to curtailed tenure.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees duration itself, rather than only the attempted expulsion, become the object of the verdict.
findings.containment: The local clause allows a short remaining; it does not claim that no interval follows.

epistemic.reason: The consequence, negation, exception, and final duration measure jointly support the bounded core.

findings.title: Implied duration measure
findings.claim: The final qualifier can measure an unspoken duration of staying, making the time-span present without a separate word for time.
findings.mechanism: Yelbathun supplies the event and qalilan supplies its accusative measure; the attachment evidence allows an elided duration reading while leaving state or measure analyses open.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader notices how the clause compresses a time-span into its final qualifier.
findings.containment: The packet leaves the accusative's exact attachment options open; this does not settle one parse over another.

epistemic.reason: QAC and attachment evidence support the implied-duration analysis but preserve more than one grammatical attachment.

findings.title: Local counter-result
findings.claim: Within this ayah, the agents' brief remaining prevents the attempted expulsion from reading as a lasting victory.
findings.mechanism: The threatened removal in the first block meets idhan, negated staying, and the final little measure; the consequence turns their hostile aim back toward their own limited tenure.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees how the result counters the threatened outcome without the focus naming a new helper.
findings.containment: The prior no-helper/protection frame proposed in the support is not used because no exact context unit is supplied; no divine agency is inferred from this local consequence alone.

epistemic.reason: The two blocks of the focus support a counter-result, while the candidate's prior-frame extension lacks a selected context unit.

findings.title: Agency pressure in variants
findings.claim: The canonical clause presents their remaining as a negated Form I imperfect, while the cited variants keep open questions about agency, permission, and persistence.
findings.mechanism: The local canonical form remains in control; the supplied variant comparison tests how the staying event could be attributed without changing the focus's ordinary result.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader notices that grammatical agency is a live pressure in the variant evidence.
findings.containment: No variant is ranked or substituted for the canonical Form I indicative, and the packet's summary does not license choosing among them.

epistemic.reason: The packet supplies the canonical morphology and a trusted variant summary, but not enough detail here to resolve the variants' exact force.

findings.title: Cadence collapse
findings.claim: The extended cadence of yelbathun falls into qalilan's shorter final measure, so sound follows the reduction in duration.
findings.mechanism: The long imperfect form sustains the staying clause until the shorter closing qualifier contracts it; the phonetic support ties the cadence change to the semantic limit.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader hears the sentence's duration narrow at its end.
findings.containment: The sound relation supports the closing effect but does not prescribe a single recitation pace.

epistemic.reason: The packet supplies phonetic comparison and a local semantic pairing; the acoustic-to-duration effect remains interpretive.

findings.title: Adverbial aftermath
findings.claim: Khilafaka measures the group's remaining in relation to the Prophet, ordinarily as time after him and exploratorily as a party left in his wake.
findings.mechanism: Its accusative adverbial attachment links it to yelbathun; the ordinary after-you branch supplies temporal orientation, while the attempted departure and the remaining verb independently permit a bounded left-behind image.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees both the temporal measure and a possible scene of those who remain behind a departing figure.
findings.containment: The temporal adverbial is the recoverable reading. The left-behind facet is exploratory and imports no journey, battle, or historical group.

epistemic.reason: The temporal syntax is direct; the additional qualified branch is triggered locally but remains a secondary image.

findings.containment: Temporal aftermath remains required by the syntax. Opposition is a bounded local overlay, not a substitute gloss.

epistemic.reason: The source support keeps temporal syntax in control and supplies local hostile actions as the independent trigger for the oppositional branch.

branch_activations.activation: The opposed action gives the carrier's separate-direction core an independent local contact.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The after-you relation can also be heard as taking a stance against the addressed person.

findings.reader_payoff: The clause briefly sustains the aftermath and then closes it down.
findings.containment: This is a local order-and-cadence effect, not a claim about elapsed time beyond the final qualifier.

findings.title: Pronoun role reversal
findings.claim: The addressed Prophet shifts from object of the hostile verbs to the reference point for the group's duration.
findings.mechanism: Ka marks him as object in yastafizzunaka and yukhrijuka, then as the possessor/reference of khilafaka; the suffix's grammatical role changes while the addressee remains the same.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader notices a structural reversal in how the same person relates to the clause.
findings.containment: The suffix remains grammatically attached to different word types; this is a relation shift, not a change in the addressee.

epistemic.reason: QAC distinguishes the earlier direct-object suffixes from the possessive suffix on the aftermath adverbial.

findings.title: Succession over the land-domain
findings.claim: Khilafaka can carry a local, exploratory succession-space over the threatened land, in addition to its ordinary after-you relation.
findings.mechanism: The intended expulsion supplies a possible vacancy and the clause about remaining after the Prophet supplies a possible one-after-another relation; the supplied succession branch then colors the aftermath.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the aftermath as a failed attempt to stand in another's place, not only as a time interval.
findings.containment: The 2:30 family-range comparison is excluded. The focus does not state that the group actually replaces, governs, or succeeds the Prophet; temporal after-you remains intact.

epistemic.reason: The branch is supplied and the removal/remaining relation is local, but replacement is an inference that the candidate itself bounds away from literal local sense.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Sonradan gelen, öncekinin yerini veya işlevini üstlenir.
branch_activations.carrier: Khilafaka carries the possible coming-after-and-taking-place relation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The purpose clause attempts to remove the addressee and the result clause measures who remains after him.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The aftermath can be heard as a would-be successor-space whose duration is curtailed.
branch_activations.boundary: No successful replacement or rule is asserted; the direct adverbial reading remains primary.

findings.title: Exception restriction
findings.claim: Illa completes the restriction by admitting only the final little remainder after the negated staying.
findings.mechanism: The exception particle attaches after la yelbathun and leads directly to qalilan; it closes the negation by limiting what can remain.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final qualifier as the only allowance left in the clause.
findings.containment: The construction denies durable staying but still permits a brief interval.

epistemic.reason: QAC identifies illa as the exception particle completing the negated-result construction.

findings.title: Final focus
findings.claim: The compact exception particle narrows attention toward qalilan as the clause's sole allowance.
findings.mechanism: Illa resolves the preceding la and places the final measure at the end of its scope, so the sentence's focus falls on the small remainder.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader feels the result clause tighten toward its last word.
findings.containment: The focus effect does not change the exception's grammatical scope or add a second exception.

epistemic.reason: The particle order and final placement support a focal closing effect beyond the particle's basic restrictive function.

findings.title: Brief and slight verdict
findings.claim: Qalilan measures a brief duration and can also render the adversaries' aftermath slight in significance.
findings.mechanism: The smallness carrier modifies the staying result; its value-oriented facet is activated by the contrast between their near-hostile success and the little tenure that follows.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the group's aftermath reduced in both length and weight.
findings.containment: Brief duration remains the grammatical reading. Evaluative slightness is an added pressure, not a replacement or a claim that the people themselves are literally small.

epistemic.reason: The candidate's local grammar selects duration, while its support and focus contrast permit a bounded value overlay.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.

findings.title: Local brief-stay pairing

findings.title: Closing sound
findings.claim: The indefinite accusative ending lets the final small measure land audibly at the end of the ayah.
findings.mechanism: Qalilan occupies the closing position, and its supplied tanwin/sound evidence gives the curtailed duration a light terminal cadence.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader hears the result settle on a small remainder.
findings.containment: The acoustic note supports closure but does not imply that tanwin alone encodes the semantic smallness or prescribe pausal recitation.

epistemic.reason: The focus position and phonetic support ground the cadence, while the sound-to-meaning relation remains interpretive.

findings.title: Exclusive remainder
findings.claim: The final small measure is the only description left after negation and exception.
findings.mechanism: La first denies durable staying, illa then admits a remainder, and qalilan supplies its sole permitted size; the end of the construction excludes any larger tenure.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees smallness as the only remainder left standing.
findings.containment: The clause allows a brief interval; exclusivity concerns the permitted measure, not absolute nonexistence.

epistemic.reason: The supplied la-illa construction and final qualifier explicitly limit the remaining.

findings.title: Final duration measure
findings.claim: The accusative qalilan completes the remaining clause as a measure of duration, while the exact attachment remains open.
findings.mechanism: Yelbathun provides the measured staying event; la and illa restrict it, and the final accusative can qualify an elided duration or function as a direct measure.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final word doing grammatical work rather than serving only as emphasis.
findings.containment: The bundle preserves the competing attachment analyses without ranking them.

epistemic.reason: QAC and attachment support link the accusative to the remaining clause while leaving its precise parse unresolved.

findings.title: Near threat, little aftermath
findings.claim: The ayah closes the group's near-success frame with a little aftermath of its own.
findings.mechanism: Kadu opens the threatened action as near but unrealized; qalilan at the end measures how little the group would remain after the addressed person, turning the opening pressure toward the agents' result.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the threat's scale reverse at the close.
findings.containment: The near-action does not become completed expulsion, and the final measure does not erase the threat.

epistemic.reason: The focus's opening auxiliary and final duration measure form a local, supported relation.

findings.title: Near-displacement reversal
findings.claim: On the plain reading, the group nearly expels the Prophet and would remain only briefly after him. The focus-root contacts add a reversal: their attempt to unsettle his territorial footing does not secure theirs, and their own tenure behind him contracts to little.
findings.mechanism: Kadu marks an uncompleted approach, fzz supplies destabilizing motion, and kh-r-j gives the outward vector; the negated staying verb, after-you relation, and qll measure then turn the threatened displacement back toward the agents' own short tenure.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the attempted removal's vector reverse: the threatened person's footing is targeted, while the aggressors' place after him is the part that fails to last.
findings.containment: The ordinary land-domain comes from al-ardh. The branch that makes earth specifically the lower realm opposite sky is excluded because no independent sky cue occurs; the removal remains near, not completed.

epistemic.reason: The trace coordinates and roots agree with QAC, but the composite reversal comes from a legacy-unbound nomination and is retained as an attributed local synthesis.
